decisions.rationale: Day 6 of 14, no project, no invite, no milestone despite kickoff held (calendar:40e18d32) and two outreaches. Customer explicitly says they've been heads-down elsewhere and haven't dug in (email:d11cd066), signalling low near-term intent; Pro plan and held kickoff give some baseline chance within 8 days.

draft.body:

invalid projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them. If it's easier, I'm happy to hop on a short call this week and get that first project set up with you so it's done and off your list.
